exam_scheme.note: The Jamia Millia Islamia Entrance Examination is conducted by the Office of the Controller of Examinations, Jamia Millia Islamia (a Central University established by an Act of Parliament), New Delhi, for admission into over 130 undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and advanced diploma programmes across arts, sciences, engineering, social sciences, education, and law. (While Jamia offers select undergraduate and postgraduate courses through CUET, the majority of specialized courses continue under Jamia's dedicated university admission tests). The entrance examination is an offline pen-and-paper test administered using OMR sheets with a standard duration of 105 minutes (1 hour 45 minutes) carrying 100 multiple-choice questions (100 marks) in undergraduate and postgraduate tests (for professional programmes like B.A. LL.B., B.Ed., and MBA, tests carry 150 to 170 questions of 120 to 180 minutes duration). Marking scheme: 1 mark awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 0.25 marks deducted for each incorrect response (-0.25), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
